Loss report: gitea -> tekton
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.push: Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag: Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.cache: shared workspace (the workspace is mounted at /pipemaster; cache paths are not copied in or out and nothing persists between runs; to persist, the operator binds a PVC (or an object store step) that outlives the PipelineRun)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present preamble in the script (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the script starts with a line that re-runs it under bash -e when the image has bash, else it runs under sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
